Description: HRC-built V-twin superbike created specifically to beat Ducati in World Superbikes, achieving championship glory with Colin Edwards.
The K1 redefined open-class superbikes with brutal power, while the legendary 2005 K5 model is widely considered one of the greatest superbikes ever built.
Introduced Moto-GP derived crossplane crankshaft technology to production road bikes, producing a distinctive V4-like roar and tractability.
A raw, unfiltered 175bhp liter-bike monster renowned for its explosive power-to-weight ratio and fierce character.
Introduced Unit Pro-Link suspension and electronic steering dampers; the 2008 redesign delivered ultra-compact dimensions and effortless speed.
High-revving 17,500 RPM supersport masterpiece featuring fly-by-wire throttle and aggressive track-focused geometry.
Hyper-touring titan engineered to challenge the Hayabusa with massive torque, 200PS, and high-speed stability.
Upgraded with a 1340cc engine producing 194bhp, refined electronics, and updated hyperbike aerodynamics.
Retro-styled muscular big-bore naked machine combining classic late-70s aesthetics with bulletproof modern fuel injection.
Bizarre and brilliant engineering crossover pairing a massive 1670cc air-cooled V-twin cruiser motor with sports chassis components.
The ultimate accessible middleweight V-twin, beloved by road commuters, track day enthusiasts, and club racers alike.
Aggressively styled super-naked that revived Kawasaki's Z brand with distinct quad quad-pipe exhausts.
1832cc flat-six touring monarch featuring reverse gear, combined ABS, integrated audio, and even an optional airbag.
Long-haul sports tourer legendary for covering continent-crossing distances with effortless shaft-driven power.
The biggest air/oil-cooled four-cylinder naked muscle bike, delivering low-end torque in abundance.
Compact 650cc parallel-twin middleweight that became the bedrock for commuter riding and Isle of Man Lightweight TT racing.
Supercharged 998cc engineering tour de force, outputting 200+ hp in road trim and 310+ hp in track-only H2R form.
Launched Yamaha's 'Dark Side of Japan' ethos with a punchy 847cc CP3 triple engine, reigniting the affordable naked market.
Revived the legendary nameplate with a balanced 21-inch front wheel adventure layout and optional Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT).
No-nonsense, rally-inspired adventure bike built around the beloved CP2 engine, prioritizing off-road capability.
An authentic road-legal MotoGP bike for the public; limited production hand-built V4 machine costing £137k at launch.
Homologation-grade superbike equipped with Öhlins electronic suspension, carbon bodywork, and 6-axis IMU electronics.
Introduced mechanical Variable Valve Timing (VVT) directly adapted from Suzuki's GSX-RR MotoGP program.
Masterclass modern-classic paying tribute to the 1972 Z1 900 with tear-drop tank styling and smooth 948cc four-cylinder performance.
Best-selling middleweight naked bike powered by the ultra-flexible 689cc crossplane parallel-twin CP2 motor.
Technological showcase debuting Honda's revolutionary Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) in a 1237cc V4 shaft-drive shell.
Consistently the UK's best-selling sports tourer, offering real-world ergonomics with high-performance 1043cc four-cylinder power.
Dependable, practical long-distance adventure machine powered by a torquey 90-degree V-twin engine.
Stylish middleweight featuring retro-futuristic aesthetics, screaming inline-four power, and iconic waterfall exhaust headers.
Stripped-back hyper-naked based on the crossplane R1 superbike chassis and engine, tuned for maximum street torque.
Balanced supercharged hyper-tourer offering effortless 200hp overtaking performance with panniers and electronic suspension.
Modern homage to Hans Muth's original 1981 Katana icon, built around the long-stroke GSX-R1000 K5 engine base.
Cult mini-moto phenomenon that spawned a global custom subculture and renewed youth interest in riding.
Track-focused redesign with MotoGP aero winglets, 214bhp, and ultra-short stroke engine built to dominate World Superbikes.
Revived the legendary 400cc 16,000 RPM high-revving inline-four supersport category for the modern era.
Third-generation hyperbike featuring modern 6-axis IMU suite, launch control, and updated aerodynamic bodywork.
Reinvented middleweight naked powered by a high-output 270-degree parallel twin engine, disrupting the price-to-performance market.
Stunning retro sports bike wearing 1980s YZR500 Grand Prix fairing styling over the modern 890cc CP3 chassis.
Suzuki's modern 776cc parallel-twin platform featuring cross balancer tech, setting new middleweight standards.
World's first strong hybrid production motorcycle, pairing a 451cc twin with an electric motor for e-boost acceleration.
Resurrected dual-purpose adventure badge providing accessible touring capability and versatile daily performance.
Accessible supersport bike utilizing the punchy CP2 twin motor in a lightweight, razor-sharp supersport frame.
Kept pure 600-class supersports alive with updated styling, TFT display, and Euro5+ compliant 636cc high-rev engine.
Off-road focused adventure machine with 21-inch front wheel and long travel suspension, winning middleweight comparisons.
Pioneered electronic clutch technology allowing clutchless starting, stopping, and gear shifting without stalled engines.
Radical leaning multi-wheel (LMW) sport tourer powered by the CP3 triple, offering unprecedented front-end cornering grip.
Sharp-edged grand tourer based on the GSX-R1000 engine, featuring hard luggage, cruise control, and connected TFT dash.
Flagship supercharged hyper-naked bike producing 197bhp with extreme Sugomi styling and electronic chassis control.
Neo-retro café racer featuring a rocket fairing around the torque-rich 1084cc Africa Twin parallel twin power plant.
The long-awaited CP3-powered supersport flagship filling the void left by the road-going R1, featuring full winglets and race chassis.
